cases.source:
claim:
    ? forall f,g,h fn(x R) R:
        $Reg::main::is_unary_c_k_on_open(R,1,f)
        forall x R:
            h(x)=f(x)+g(x)
        =>:
            $Reg::main::is_unary_c_k_on_open(R,1,h)
    release thm RegLaws::main::unary_c_k_linear_combination(R,1,f,g,h,1,1)

claim:
    ? forall f,g,h fn(x R) R:
        $Reg::main::is_unary_c_k_on_open(R,1,f)
        forall x R:
            h(x)=f(x)+0*g(x)
        =>:
            $Reg::main::is_unary_c_k_on_open(R,1,h)
    release thm RegLaws::main::unary_c_k_linear_combination(R,1,f,g,h,1,0)

claim:
    ? forall f,g,h fn(x R) R:
        $Reg::main::is_unary_c_k_on_open(R,3,f)
        $Reg::main::is_unary_c_k_on_open(R,3,g)
        forall x R:
            h(x)=f(x)+g(x)
        =>:
            $Reg::main::is_unary_smooth_on_open(R,h)
    release thm RegLaws::main::unary_smooth_linear_combination(R,f,g,h,1,1)

claim:
    ? forall f,g,h fn(x cart_n(R,2)) R:
        $Reg::main::is_scalar_c_k_on_open(2,cart_n(R,2),2,f)
        forall x cart_n(R,2):
            h(x)=f(x)+g(x)
        =>:
            $Reg::main::is_scalar_c_k_on_open(2,cart_n(R,2),2,h)
    release thm RegLaws::main::scalar_c_k_linear_combination(2,cart_n(R,2),2,f,g,h,1,1)
